tasks.title: Prepare for and register a visitor

4.2.2.title: Visitors
4.2.2.text:
Visitors are required to:

• Be informed of site-specific safety rules relevant to their visit at the start of each visit.

5.1.title: Verra Mobility Sites
5.1.text:
All Verra Mobility sites must have:
• A Visitor Register Form (IMS.03.20.FRM.01) for Visitors to sign in
• Emergency evacuation maps available where visitors sign in, and
• Visitor identification labels for Visitors to wear.

6.3.title: Visitor Exit Procedure
6.3.text:
• All visitors must exit the workplace under the direction of their Host and sign out using
the designated visitor register or system, and
• The Host must ensure visitor passes, access cards, and temporary credentials are
returned and that the visitor has left all controlled areas.

4.1.2.title: Visitors
4.1.2.text:
Visitors are responsible for:
• Complying with Verra Mobility instructions and site rules
• Following safety directions and signage
• Wearing required PPE
• Not entering restricted areas unless authorized, and

• Reporting hazards, incidents, or injuries immediately to their Host

4.2.1.title: Verra Mobility Employees
4.2.1.text:
Verra Mobility Employees are required to:

• Complete the Visitor Training Module (IMS.03.20.TRN.01) annually.

6.1.title: Visitor Registration Procedure
6.1.text:
i. The host shall meet the visitor in the sign in area
ii. All visitors must sign in on arrival using the designated visitor sign-in system or
register
iii. The host shall inform the relevant site safety rules including emergency evacuation
requirements, and
iv. The host shall determine if a Visitor shall be escorted or unescorted during their time
on site and inform the visitor of movement restrictions.

4.1.title: Specific Roles and Responsibilities Related to this Procedure
4.1.text:
4.1.1. Hosts
Hosts are responsible for:
• Complying with this Procedure
• Ensuring Visitors sign in and out as required
• Determining whether Visitors are escorted or unescorted
• Providing relevant safety information and instructions
• Ensuring Visitors comply with site rules and PPE requirements, and
• Remaining responsible for visitors for the duration of their visit.
4.1.2. Visitors
Visitors are responsible for:
• Complying with Verra Mobility instructions and site rules
• Following safety directions and signage
• Wearing required PPE
• Not entering restricted areas unless authorized, and

• Reporting hazards, incidents, or injuries immediately to their Host

4.2.title: Competency Requirements
4.2.text:
4.2.1. Verra Mobility Employees
Verra Mobility Employees are required to:

• Complete the Visitor Training Module (IMS.03.20.TRN.01) annually.
4.2.2. Visitors
Visitors are required to:

• Be informed of site-specific safety rules relevant to their visit at the start of each visit.

6.2.title: Visitor Restrictions Management Procedure
6.2.text:
6.2.1. Escorted Visitors
Escorted Visitors:
• Visitors cannot conduct any high risk works under any circumstances
• Must sign in and out on arrival and departure, and
• Must always remain under the direct supervision of their Host.
6.2.2. Unescorted Visitors
Unescorted Visitors may be permitted where:
• Visitors cannot conduct any high risk works under any circumstances
• The visitor attends for prolonged periods, or

• The visitor is required to work independently

4.1.1.title: Hosts
4.1.1.text:
Hosts are responsible for:
• Complying with this Procedure
• Ensuring Visitors sign in and out as required
• Determining whether Visitors are escorted or unescorted
• Providing relevant safety information and instructions
• Ensuring Visitors comply with site rules and PPE requirements, and
• Remaining responsible for visitors for the duration of their visit.

6.4.title: Visitor Incident, Near Miss and Hazard Management Procedure
6.4.text:
All Incidents, near misses and hazards must be reported as per the Incident, Near Miss and
Hazard Management Procedure (IMS.06.01.PRO.01).
